notes.title: New gun and 3 new perks!
notes.content:
This demo update features a new gun: the Black Hole Generator. Those holes pull in nearly everything — enemies, crates, projectiles, gibs... but for some reason, not the Raccoon 🤔 The holes can also be used to protect yourself from enemies' projectiles!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45081019/8156330a8b38ff69e011123478930271fa164373.gif[/img]

Also, there are 3 new perks:
[list]
[*]Suspicious Pills — the player and the enemies move faster. Great for experienced platforming players!
[*]Time Core — slows down enemies, but slightly increases the amount spawned.
[*]Piercing Ammo — bullets pierce through a wall of enemies.
[/list]

Small improvements:
[list]
[*]shadows under platforms that add depth to the scene.
[*]wall bullet impact particles.
[*]changing backgrounds animation.
[*]dash sound (how could I forget it?)
[*]other small technical fixes.
[/list]

notes.title: Daily run mode is available in the demo!
notes.content:
In the new [b]Daily run[/b] game mode, each new day presents a new [i]equal[/i] challenge to every player. Everyone gets the same Tower layout, weapons, and perks — and has only one chance to get the highest score for that day.
The new Daily run is available at midnight UTC.

Other updates:
[list]
[*] added Steam Rich Presence feature — now your friends will know about your current run's progress:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45081019/5770fb1bfaf55cc6b40ff4a332a7d052598fa5b4.png[/img]
[*] added a leaderboards screen where you can view entire leaderboards, not just scores around yours — both Infinite mode and Daily runs:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45081019/8573c38cdc6f550b631cdcaee65ccf0dcf8c09bd.png[/img]
[*] added Streamer Friendly mode — reduces background movement and post-processing effects so that uploads to YouTube or live streams have fewer compression artifacts. It can be enabled on the tutorial screen or in the options menu.
[*] fixed some small bugs and crashes (please report in the comments if you still encounter anything strange!)
[/list]

notes.title: Demo is out now!
notes.content:
The demo is released, along with the small new trailer showcasing all the fun (and the explosions) you can experience in it!

What's in the demo:
[list]
[*] Infinite Tower game mode — practice, try out different perks, and climb the leaderboards!
[*] 18 weapons
[*] 24 perks
[*] 6 enemy types
[*] 1 boss
[/list]
Btw, the demo is perfect on the Steam Deck!

What to expect from the full game:
[list]
[*] Story mode where you will meet different characters, discover hidden secrets of the Tower, and receive permanent upgrades between runs
[*] Different biomes and bosses — do you like icy caves, moving platforms, and lava pits?
[*] Much more weapons and perks
[*] Customizable hats 🎩
[/list]
What else do you like to see in the full game? Let me know in the comments!
